verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair axis for a simulation platform. The only on-point evidence is a documented workflow that captures stereo camera data automatically when an AMR nears objects of interest. Beyond that there is only a generic claim that developers can "automate workflows." Neither shows a general facility for defining rules that fire actions on events. Missing for 10: a documented rule/trigger definition mechanism, a catalog of supported events and actions, depth beyond a single tutorial-style example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
